newsitem.title: UK: Euromoney to buy Institutional Investor.
newsitem.headline: Euromoney to buy Institutional Investor.

text.p: Euromoney Publications Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Institutional Investor Inc from ABC Inc, an indirect subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, for 84 million pounds ($142 million) in cash.
Euromoney said in a statement it would fund the buy with a $150 million medium-term bank facility provided by HSBC Group at an interest rate of LIBOR plus 0.5 percent.

Financial publishing firm Euromoney said Associated Newspapers Holdings Limited, a subsidiary of Daily Mail & General Trust Plc, had undertaken to vote in favour of resolutions on the deal, which would be put to an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders.
Associated Newspapers owns 72.5 percent of Euromoney. The shareholder meeting will be as soon as practicable.

"The combination will bring together two strong brand names in international financial publishing," Euromoney said, adding Institutional Investor derives 73 percent of its revenues within the US while most of Euromoney's financial publishing revenues are international.

Euromoney said it believed the two groups would fit well. Institutional Investor publishes Institutional Investor magazine which has two editions. It also publishes 23 newsletters and has a conference division as well as publishing 12 journals, research and bank data.
